text: The steward role never calls a model: steward.rs counts repeated failure classes, and its stored prompt reaches nothing. Make it what the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-14: A loop that steers Athena, roles, and a ladder of requirements' describes: an agent with that short stable prompt and liberal read access to everything about Athena (code, prompts, briefs, records, git history, and GitHub CI, PRs and deploys fetched where they live), that works out what should change and queues it.
